user_story: As a user I list redacted vault secret metadata by namespace/prefix.
expected_behavior: `GET /api/vault/secrets?namespace=&prefix=` returns redacted metadata; prefix must match namespace.
documented_errors: None observed during isolated HTTP and UDS-backed CLI QA. Browser vault list visual state remains blocked by browser.mode=blocked.
notes: API list by namespace/prefix returned redacted metadata; namespace/prefix mismatch returned 400. CLI list emits a metadata array directly, while HTTP wraps under secrets.

user_story: As a user I fetch metadata for one secret ref.
expected_behavior: `GET /api/vault/secrets/metadata?ref=` returns redacted metadata; missing ref 400.
documented_errors: None observed during isolated HTTP and UDS-backed CLI QA.
notes: Metadata lookup returned redacted metadata only. Missing ref returned 400; unknown ref returned 404. CLI get emits the metadata object directly.

user_story: As a user I store a write-only secret and get redacted metadata back.
expected_behavior: `PUT /api/vault/secrets` validates ref (`vault:` prefix), stores value, returns metadata only; registers redaction.
documented_errors: None observed during isolated HTTP and UDS-backed CLI QA. Browser editor validation remains blocked by browser.mode=blocked.
notes: PUT and CLI value-stdin stored a temporary vault:sessions secret and returned only metadata. Batch scan found no raw qa-ms-vault-secret value in evidence.

user_story: As a user I delete a vault secret (typed confirm cross-scope).
expected_behavior: `DELETE /api/vault/secrets?ref=` → 204; web requires typed-confirm for non-session refs, immediate for `vault:sessions/`.
documented_errors: None observed during isolated HTTP and UDS-backed CLI QA. Web typed-confirm gate for non-session refs remains browser-blocked.
notes: DELETE returned 204, metadata after delete returned 404, and CLI delete of the already-removed ref reported not found. Temporary secret was deleted in cleanup.
